auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to keep your streak alive.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a link to set a new one.
auth.signupSubtitle: Two minutes of setup, then your targets are ready.
auth.name: Name
auth.linkExpiredHint: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a fresh one and try again.
auth.chooseNewPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. You'll be signed in right after.

account.title: Account
account.languageHint: The app's language. Food names stay as they were entered.
account.unitsHint: How weights and heights are shown. Your data is stored in metric either way.
account.fastingHint: Optional: set your daily eating window and the dashboard shows whether it's open. A window past midnight (e.g. 20:00 to 04:00) works too. Clear both fields to disable.
account.yourDataHint: Download everything you've logged. It's your data — take it anywhere.
account.deleteHint: Permanently removes your account and everything in it — profile, diary, weight history, favorites, recipes and foods you created. There is no undo.

status.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
status.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — check your inbox for the link.
status.emailTaken: An account already exists for that email.
status.emailInvalid: That email address doesn't look right.
status.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
status.samePassword: That's already your password. Pick a new one.
status.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
status.signupDisabled: New sign-ups are closed right now.
status.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Log in again.
status.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then log in.
status.resetLinkSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
status.checkYourDetails: Please double-check your details — some values look off.
status.couldNotSave: We couldn't save that. Try again.

onboarding.title: Tell us about your body. We'll do the math.
onboarding.intro: These numbers feed the Mifflin-St Jeor equation for your BMR, then your training frequency sets the multiplier for TDEE. Your daily calorie and macro targets update live as you type.
onboarding.birthDateHint: Age is part of the BMR equation.
onboarding.sectionMacrosHint: How your calories divide into protein, carbs and fat. Pick what suits how you like to eat — you can change it any time.
onboarding.coachFormulaHint: Protein pinned to your bodyweight ({proteinPerKg} g/kg for your goal), fat at 25% of calories, carbs fill the rest. Protein-forward — heavier than some people want.
onboarding.customSplitHint: Set your own percentages — they just need to total 100.
onboarding.splitInvalid: Currently {sum}% — the three must total 100% ({min}–{max}% each).
onboarding.changeLater: You can change all of this later.
onboarding.completeToUnlock: Complete all three sections to unlock.

activity.sedentaryDetail: Desk job, little or no exercise
activity.athleteDetail: Twice daily training or physical job

macroPreset.highcarbDetail: Fuel-first for endurance or heavy training days.
macroPreset.lowcarbDetail: Fat becomes the main fuel, carbs stay minimal.
